description:
PROBLEM. Several platform errors and setup prompts tell users to set flags, platform options or environment variables that BenchBox does not accept, so following the advice does not work. Verified on origin/develop 07de4cd: - ClickHouse Cloud (benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/setup.py:80-85): names `--clickhouse-cloud-password` (no such option). Accepted: `--platform-option password=` / CLICKHOUSE_CLOUD_PASSWORD and `--platform-option oauth_token=` / CLICKHOUSE_CLOUD_OAUTH_TOKEN (platforms/__init__.py:650,657; setup.py:67,71). Check whether the argparse `--password`/`--clickhouse-cloud-oauth-token` group in clickhouse_cloud.py:98-116 is reachable from any user CLI and name the forms users actually use. - Snowflake run error (platforms/snowflake.py:124,136): names SNOWFLAKE_USER and implies `benchbox run` reads SNOWFLAKE_* variables. It reads none (saved credentials only, config_utils.py:61; no username/password platform options, platforms/__init__.py:753-754). Setup auto-detect reads SNOWFLAKE_USERNAME (credentials/snowflake.py:276). The setup prompt (credentials/snowflake.py:288) lists 'ACCOUNT, USERNAME' instead of the variable names. - Redshift (platforms/redshift.py:189,197): names REDSHIFT_USER; setup reads REDSHIFT_USERNAME (credentials/redshift.py:436); run reads none. - BigQuery (platforms/bigquery.py:146): offers BIGQUERY_PROJECT as a run-time option; the adapter reads only config (:102); setup reads GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS and BIGQUERY_PROJECT. - Glue (platforms/aws/glue_adapter.py:84-89): advises `--staging-root` (no such flag) and BENCHBOX_S3_STAGING_DIR (never read); the real route is `--output s3://...` (orchestrator.py:317). - cloud_spark external tables (platforms/cloud_spark/external_tables.py:44-45): advises `s3_staging_dir` / `gcs_staging_dir` platform options that are not registered for glue, emr-serverless, dataproc-serverless, so following it ends in 'Unknown platform option' (platform_hooks.py:128-132). CHANGE. Each message states the real flow in user terms: run-time options it accepts, or `benchbox setup --platform

` plus the exact variables setup reads. Default: fix messages, not behaviour. Then sweep every remaining platform adapter and credential module for configuration/credential messages naming flags, options or variables, and fix any further mismatch. changelog.d fragment (fix).
